adaptations.logcei: Stable log-EI; objective GP uses all trusted completed exact objectives, including explicitly infeasible designs. Constraint/completion GPCs use sign-resolved evidence. Overlapping intervals and unknown outputs are omitted; kernel hyperparameters are fixed.
adaptations.nsga2_adapted: Sequential mixed-variable evolutionary adapter with declared evidence-first constraint ordering then observed feasible objective. Missing objectives stay missing. Not an official NSGA-II implementation or exact reproduction.
adaptations.scbo_adapted: Single-point candidate-pool adapter with exact categorical equality and active continuous trust-region distances. Incumbent includes initial labels and never regresses. Bernoulli feasibility sampling is not reference SCBO constraint sampling.
adaptations.sego_utb_adapted: Independent exact-value GPs, fixed 1.96 upper-confidence feasible set, completion/sign evidence weighting and explicit restoration. Missing constraints are not fabricated as numbers. Not a full SEGO-UTB reproduction.

anchor_policy: anchors checked and reported, never used to select a case or seed; only explicit anchored policy uses them
baseline_note: conventional_eic is our numeric-only hierarchical one-hot adaptation; not official CBOB/SCBO

comparison_protocol.candidate_generation: shared exact-screened pool; RA adds local candidates and NSGA-II may propose validated offspring
comparison_protocol.reason_original_lsbo_omitted: Historical/secondary reference; this screen prioritizes external algorithms.

flight_risk: post-optimization validation only; nominal optimizer is not a chance-constrained physical-risk optimizer
initial_policy: random draws never rejected using feasibility labels; warm/cold reported after evaluation

methods.logcei: logCEI, independent one-hot GP models with completion/constraint classifiers
methods.nsga2_adapted: NSGA-II-style mixed-variable evolutionary search with feasibility-first ranking
methods.random: Uniform random search over the exact-screened candidate pool
methods.scbo_adapted: SCBO-style constrained Thompson sampling with mixed-variable trust region
methods.sego_utb_adapted: SEGO-UTB-style EI over a GP upper-confidence feasible set

sparsity: ordinary/sparse are prospective task names, actual fractions and binomial intervals must be reported
statistical_claim: smoke/pilot exploratory; confirm is a candidate protocol, not automatic publication evidence

settings.feedback: region violation returns only a sign and skips the objective
